question:
The value of the following expression is:

197 - [1 over9 {42 + (56 - 8 +9)} + 108]
solution:
**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b50f2efd1bb72b293c402aea2d4f550402a30fe28f85bae2037667b3f637d919.png] 

Solution:

⇒ 197 - [1 over9 {42 + (56 - 8 +9)} + 108]

⇒ 197 - [1 ÷ 9 × 99 + 108]

⇒ 197 - [11 + 108]

⇒ 197 - 119

⇒ 78

**Therefore, the value of the expression is 78.**
